description: Source code for the torch::jit::Module class and related functions, implementing module cloning, serialization, inference optimization, and other module operations in PyTorch JIT.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a serializable, cloneable neural network module with parameters, attributes, submodules, and methods.

classes.name: Method
classes.description: Encapsulates a method of a Module, allowing invocation, async execution, and argument management.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the module, optionally ignoring specified methods and attributes.

methods.name: deepcopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the module, optionally on a specified device.

methods.name: clone_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for cloning a module with type remapping and ignoring specified methods/attributes.

methods.name: clone_method
methods.description: Clones a specific method from another module, remapping types.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns a list of parameters of the module.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns a list of named parameters of the module.

methods.name: attributes
methods.description: Returns a list of attributes of the module.

methods.name: named_attributes
methods.description: Returns a list of named attributes of the module.

methods.name: buffers
methods.description: Returns a list of buffers of the module.

methods.name: named_buffers
methods.description: Returns a list of named buffers of the module.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns immediate child modules.

methods.name: named_children
methods.description: Returns named immediate child modules.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns all descendant modules.

methods.name: named_modules
methods.description: Returns all descendant modules with names.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module and its submodules to training or evaluation mode.

methods.name: create_class
methods.description: Creates a new class object of the module's type with given arguments.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Freezes a module for inference, removing training-specific attributes.

methods.name: optimize_for_inference
methods.description: Optimizes a module's graph for inference by fusing and converting operations.

methods.name: dump_to_str
methods.description: Serializes the module's structure and optionally its contents to a string.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Prints the module's structure and contents to stdout.
